questions.prompt: May the gods keep our homeland safe from savage enemies!
questions.answer: Utinam dī patriam nostram ā ferīs hostibus servent!

questions.prompt: Would that the general may return victorious from the war!
questions.answer: Utinam dux victor ā bellō redeat!

questions.prompt: May they not abandon the walls besieged by the enemy!
questions.answer: Nē moenia ab hoste obsessa dēserant!

questions.prompt: Oh that I may be a false prophet about these dangers!
questions.answer: Utinam falsus vātēs dē hīs perīculīs sim!

questions.prompt: May the immortal gods grant us a peaceful year!
questions.answer: Dī immortālēs nōbīs placidum annum dent!

questions.prompt: May health and long life be given to you, dear friend!
questions.answer: Utinam salūs et longa vīta tibi, cāre amīce, dentur!

questions.prompt: May the gods prevent so wicked a crime!
questions.answer: Dī tam scelestum facinus prohibeant!

questions.prompt: Would that you were now telling the truth from your heart!
questions.answer: Utinam vēra nunc ex animō dīcerēs!

questions.prompt: Would that our leader were still alive and ruling the city!
questions.answer: Utinam dux noster adhūc vīveret et urbem regeret!

questions.prompt: Would that I possessed the riches of wise Croesus!
questions.answer: Utinam dīvitiās sapientis Croesī possidērem!

questions.prompt: Would that the fields were not lying barren from the drought!
questions.answer: Utinam nē agrī siccitāte sterilēs iacērent!

questions.prompt: Would that you trusted me now, my most faithful comrade!
questions.answer: Utinam mihi nunc, fīdissime comes, crēderēs!

questions.prompt: Would that so great a burden did not press upon my shoulders!
questions.answer: Utinam nē tantum onus umerīs meīs premeret!

questions.prompt: Would that the swift ships were already sailing toward home!
questions.answer: Utinam celerēs nāvēs iam domum nāvigārent!

questions.prompt: Would that the citizens feared the anger of the gods!
questions.answer: Utinam cīvēs īram deōrum timērent!

questions.prompt: Would that Achilles had avoided the arrows of Apollo!
questions.answer: Utinam Achillēs Apollinis sagittās vītāvisset!

questions.prompt: Would that I had never set foot in that treacherous city!
questions.answer: Utinam numquam in illam perfidam urbem pedem intulissem!

questions.prompt: Would that the soldiers had not abandoned their posts in the night!
questions.answer: Utinam nē mīlitēs statiōnēs suās nocte relīquissent!

questions.prompt: Would that we had heeded the warnings of the wise old man!
questions.answer: Utinam monita sapientis senis audīvissēmus!

questions.prompt: Would that the storm had spared the fleet loaded with grain!
questions.answer: Utinam tempestās classī frūmentō onustae pepercisset!

questions.prompt: Would that I had not been born in so cruel an age!
questions.answer: Utinam nē tam crūdēlī saeculō nātus essem!

questions.prompt: May fortune favor the bold sailors on the deep sea!
questions.answer: Fortūna audācibus nautīs in altō marī faveat!

questions.prompt: Would that the traitor had not opened the gates to the enemy!
questions.answer: Utinam nē prōditor portās hostī aperuisset!
